thread:
Priya (Accounts Payable): FYI HelixML sent invoice INV-3327 for $12,400 but there's no PO on the header. Coupa rejected it with code NO_MATCH_PO. PDF: https://drive.redwood.internal/drive/4Xk8/inv-3327.pdf

invoices-bot: Routing error: approver group for GL 8002 inactive (approval-service v2.1.5)

Maya (Finance): Do we have an associated PO or contract for HelixML work?

Leo (Procurement): Looks like the work references PO-6790 in our SOW. PO-6790 status = CLOSED (end 2025-12-31). Closed POs don't auto-route for new invoices.

Priya (Accounts Payable): Also noticed vendor billed to "Redwood Corp" instead of "Redwood Inference - Corp". Coupa's fuzzy match failed. Two failure reasons: no PO and bill-to mismatch.

Tara (Vendor Ops): I'll ask HelixML to resend a corrected invoice with PO-6790 and exact Bill-To. That usually fixes auto-match. If they refuse we can run a manual retro approval. Which should we prioritize? :thinking_face:

Maya (Finance): Vendor-first path preferred to keep audit clean. @Tara please send the template.

Leo (Procurement): Alternative is reopening PO-6790 for 30 days or issuing a short-term PO. Reopen requires procurement lead signoff. I'll ping Marcus now.

invoices-bot: Manual approval ticket AP-9921 created and assigned to Accounts Payable. Link: https://ap.redwood.internal/ticket/AP-9921

Priya (Accounts Payable): I'll monitor AP-9921 and can mark as expedited if vendor provides corrected invoice. Manual retro-approval processing ETA ~1 business day once approved.

Tara (Vendor Ops): HelixML replied: they can reissue but need exact remit address + PO string. Sent them the template (attached). They asked whether PO-6790 is OK even though it's closed.

Maya (Finance): Tell them yes, instruct to put PO-6790 on the invoice and reference original INV-3327 in subject. If they can't, we'll proceed with AP-9921 manual flow.

Leo (Procurement): Quick update: Marcus tentatively approved reopening PO-6790, but I need to complete a short reopen form. Might take up to 48 hours.

Priya (Accounts Payable): Noted. I'll hold payment until either: (A) corrected invoice arrives, or (B) AP-9921 is approved.

Maya (Finance): Action items recap: (1) @Tara request HelixML resend invoice with PO=PO-6790 and Bill-To "Redwood Inference - Corp"; (2) @Leo submit reopen form for PO-6790 or create temp PO; (3) @Priya track AP-9921 and expedite when vendor reissue or PO reopen confirmed.
